test_date_func: test the DATE SQL function for casting date literals and comparing dates in polars SQL queries
test_extract: test the EXTRACT and DATE_PART SQL functions for extracting year, month, day, hour, and other temporal parts from datetime values
test_extract_errors: test that EXTRACT and DATE_PART SQL functions raise SQLSyntaxError for unsupported temporal parts like femtosecond or stroopwafel
test_extract_century_millennium: test the EXTRACT and DATE_PART SQL functions for extracting century and millennium values from dates across various years
test_implicit_temporal_strings: test implicit temporal string comparisons using date, datetime, and time types in SQL WHERE clause constraints
test_strftime: test the STRFTIME SQL function for formatting datetime, date, and time values into custom string representations
test_strptime: test the STRPTIME SQL function for parsing string columns back into datetime, date, and time types using format strings
test_temporal_stings_to_datetime: test the DATE, DATETIME, and TIME SQL functions for converting string columns to temporal types with optional format strings
test_temporal_typed_literals: test SQL typed literals using DATE, TIME, and TIMESTAMP keywords for inline temporal value construction
test_timestamp_time_unit: test casting timestamps to specific time units (ms, us, ns) using the ::timestamp syntax in polars SQL queries
